name: openspec-propose
title_zh: 设计、规格、任务清单一次到齐的变更提案生成器
tagline_zh: 别再对着空白文档发愁。说出你想建什么，它立刻产出完整变更提案——设计、规格、任务全齐，直接交给实施。
tagline_en: Stop staring at a blank doc. Describe what you want, get a full change proposal—design, specs, tasks—ready for.
desc_en: Propose a new change with all artifacts generated in one step. Use when the user wants to quickly describe what they want to build and get a complete proposal with design, specs, and tasks ready for implementation.
why_zh: 把「想清楚」和「写下来」合并成一步。它强制你在提案阶段就补齐设计决策，避免边写代码边改主意的返工循环。
why_en: Merges thinking and writing into one move. Forces design decisions upfront, killing the code-then-redesign loop.
limit_zh: 只生成提案文档，不写实现代码。需要你已有明确的技术栈偏好；对探索性、方向未定的想法，它给的结构反而会束缚你。
limit_en: Outputs proposal docs only, no implementation code. Requires you to already have tech-stack preferences; for open-ended exploration, its structure.
title_en: One-step change proposal: design, specs, tasks all generated
